name: XTUSD
oneLiner: XTUSD is XT.com's centralized dollar token, issued from limited-disclosure issuer reserves with no Pharos-modeled holder redemption route.
collateral: XT.com issuer-managed dollar reserves; public collateral detail is limited
pegMechanism: Centralized exchange-issued dollar token with issuance and account exits handled through XT.com infrastructure; no Pharos redemption backstop is modeled without source-reviewed public terms

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: XTUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: XTUSD primarily circulates on XSC, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: XTUSD is tracked from market and issuer metadata, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a public holder redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: XTUSD is a centralized dollar token issued by the XT.com exchange (Seychelles) on its own XSC chain; new tokens are minted against USD deposits and burned on redemption through XT.com infrastructure, with limited public disclosure of the on-chain mint authority.

controls.label: XT.com issuance backend
controls.evidence: Listing and aggregator coverage describe XTUSD as a deposit-and-redemption stablecoin where the XT.com exchange mints new tokens when USD is deposited and burns them on redemption; supply creation is controlled by the exchange operator with no permissionless mint route disclosed.

review.evidence: XTUSD is described across exchange listing and aggregator pages as an XT.com-issued, reserve-backed dollar token using an exchange-operated mint-on-deposit / burn-on-redemption model; no first-party technical docs expose the on-chain minter, and XSC is not indexed by Pharos.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the centralized exchange-issuer model described in third-party coverage; no first-party docs or on-chain admin read available for the XSC deployment, so confidence is held at manual-review.
unresolvedQuestions: Locate first-party XT.com documentation for the XTUSD mint/redeem terms and resolve the on-chain mint authority on XSC.
